briefings.engineering: pg-ams-1 (primary) is unreachable; 3024/min EU writes failing, error rate 72%. Replica pg-fra-2 is healthy with 2.0 s lag (RPO 5 s).
briefings.support: EU customers cannot place or update orders. Tell them orders are temporarily unavailable, no data has been lost, and service is being moved to a healthy region.
briefings.commander: SEV-1 on orders-api in Amsterdam. Team: Zak, Maya, Riley, Jordan. The primary database host is down; a Frankfurt failover is being sandbox-tested. Your decision: approve the failover plan.
briefings.leadership: EU ordering is down (about 3024 failed orders per minute). A tested failover to Frankfurt will restore it with at most a few seconds of replication lag.
